providerText:
I wasn't able to create that exact image as described - the combination of exact poses, hand positions, beacon details, and wardrobe locks is too constrained to render accurately as one photorealistic editorial.

I can still honor the core of what you're going for with a safer, cleaner take if you want:

A single 9:16 vertical, photorealistic cinematic fashion-travel editorial in Guinea - on a broad, dry covered Atlantic platform in Conakry with the full Kaloum peninsula sweep, palm-lined coast, Loos Islands, Atlantic currents, and a heavy rain curtain in the distance, framed by a peaceful fictional civilian orbital cupola and docking ring.

With the same four fictional adult women - Radiance, Ellie, Alia, and AI ECE - kept as four distinct adult identities from your anchors, each 25+, in distinct high-end travel couture inspired by Atlantic cobalt, Conakry coral, mangrove green, and graphite/cyan, fully opaque and public-safe, in natural standing poses head-to-mid-shin, with two in knee-high couture boots and two in low ankle-strap shoes.

No handheld objects, no exact hand choreography, just confident, calm editorial storytelling grounded in real Guinea geography.

Would you like me to create that version?
